title: Returns Policy
body_md:
## 14-Day Right of Withdrawal

Consumers have the right to return goods within 14 days of receipt without providing a reason, in accordance with EU consumer law.

## Conditions

- Item must be in original condition and packaging
- Include all accessories and documentation
- Contact us before returning: info@xlmarket.ee

## How to Return

1. Email info@xlmarket.ee with your order number and reason
2. We will send return instructions within 2 business days
3. Ship the item back at your cost (unless the item is defective)
4. Refund processed within 14 days of receiving the return

## Defective Items

If an item arrives damaged or defective, contact us within 48 hours with photos. We will arrange return shipping at no cost to you and issue a full refund or replacement.

## Exceptions

Items that cannot be returned: custom-ordered equipment, hygiene items (used), consumables once opened.
